articles.title: Injective receives SEC transfer agent registration for institutional services arm
articles.snippet: Injective’s affiliated entity can now maintain securities ownership records, adding regulated market infrastructure to its growing push into tokenized assets.

articles.title: Chainalysis Sues US Government Over $94.6M ICE Contract Handed to Rival TRM Labs
articles.snippet: The bid protest, filed in the U.S. Court of Federal Claims, challenges ICE's sole-source award for blockchain forensic tools, pitting the two biggest names in crypto tracing against each other.
